verdicts.fix_idea: In carryBookingDraft (features/booking/v2/booking_carry_v2.dart:42-43) always drop the trailer as the old fresh draft did: extras: _noTrailer(prev.extras), trailerMotoId: () => null, even for the same bike and same dates. That makes the form re-ask get_trailer_availability on every entry, exactly like the old look; no change to the old look or the section.
verdicts.proof: Old rule confirmed: tile only when !isKids && !selfService (core/booking_form_extras_section.dart:361) and _buildTrailerTile hides it unless selected or candidate.hasFree via trailerAvailabilityProvider -> RPC get_trailer_availability (:367-375). In the old look every entry to the form built a FRESH draft without trailer (features/booking/booking_entry.dart:65-69), so on every entry the tile was shown and a piece assigned only after a fresh availability answer. v2 inside the form: same method, same hide check, v2 row returned at :394-403 after :373-375, and the section passes trailer only when !isKids && !selfService (:245) - this part holds. But v2 adds a new entry path: startBookingFromSelection in v2 calls carryBookingDraft (booking_entry.dart:71-89), which for the SAME bike and SAME dates keeps prev.extras and prev.trailerMotoId (booking_carry_v2.dart:35-44, extras: sameDates ? null, trailerMotoId: sameDates ? null). Because the tile check short-circuits on selected = draft.trailerMotoId != null (:368, :373), the carried piece is shown ticked without any new availability check. Concrete path: customer ticks the trailer, goes back to the catalog, another customer books that trailer piece for overlapping days, the first customer taps REZERVOVAT on the same bike with the same dates -> trailer still ticked as 'Zdarma', CTA unlocked, and the refusal only comes from DB trigger trg_check_trailer_overlap at payment/insert (server yes: get_trailer_availability RPC + trg_check_trailer_overlap, STATE_3:351, STATE_4). Kids / self-service exclusions still hold (self-service normalisation booking_form_widget.dart:428-439 runs for both looks). I could not determine exactly which message the payment screen shows for a trailer-overlap trigger error on a NEW booking insert (payment_error_mapper.dart:175-177 maps trailer_unavailable for edits).

Old: startBookingFromSelection old branch always sets a fresh draft without trailer (features/booking/booking_entry.dart:65-69). v2: carryBookingDraft drops the trailer extra and trailerMotoId whenever the dates differ for the same bike (features/booking/v2/booking_carry_v2.dart:36,42-43) and for a different bike extras are either _noTrailer(prev.extras) or the fresh empty list while trailerMotoId stays the fresh null (:72, fresh.copyWith without trailerMotoId); a submitted booking or another account gets the fresh draft (:34, booking_entry.dart:76). So a trailer is never carried to a different date range. Residual difference (same bike, same dates keeps the trailer without re-checking availability) is recorded under G-207. Silent in both looks.
